authority.source: explicit user direction in the active Goal thread
authority.scope: All completed Lab research families and Optimization campaigns are eligible for outcome-aware rehabilitation triage. More than one family may be reopened, but only one research judgment stream may be active at a time.
authority.automatic_adjacent_successor_rule: Explicitly lifted for serial rehabilitation. Each reopened family must still freeze one bounded search bundle, validation design, economic gates and stop conditions before new outcomes. If that bundle yields no robust actionable region, close the family again and move to the next ranked unit.
authority.prior_closures: Historical verdicts remain immutable evidence and are not rewritten. Reopening creates a newly named successor with explicit selection-bias disclosure.
authority.live_boundary: No rehabilitated Optimization result has direct Live authority. A survivor must receive a separate user-authorized Lab engineering handoff and only CURRENT_STATE.md can authorize any Live-Dev action.

exhaustive_census.method: Directory names and every closure/result JSON were enumerated from the clean main worktree; canonical manifests sort slash-normalized paths and hash path|bytes|SHA256 lines joined by LF.

freeze the whole related variant bundle before its first new outcome

require complete valid economic numbers; engineering and environment faults remain correction states
